name: ssl-native-cs2-drum-bus
description: Clean, punchy SSL drum-bus tone + glue via the SSL Native Channel Strip 2: HPF 35 Hz, E-series EQ (low thump + de-box + air shelf), and the channel compressor in FAST-ATTACK (the mode that actually grabs drums — see plugin_build note) for ~3 dB GR. Validated on the Watercolors no-room drum bus (bus_70s_balanced.wav): crest 24.9 -> 28.96 dB (MCP measure-loudness), so the move adds punch, not just level. SSL is a CLEAN console — color is the EQ+comp, NOT drive; do NOT gain-stage into it.
intended_for: a dry / no-room drum bus (or a full mix bus, with gentler settings) that wants console tone + glue without the warmth of tape or the aggression of API
plugin_build: SSL Native Channel Strip 2.vst3 (VST3, /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/). Renders headless via Pedalboard, iLok-authorized on this rig (SSL Native = iLok — RE-VERIFY load+render on any other machine, iLok is a render-farm landmine). The channel comp's NORMAL (non-fast) attack is so transient-preserving it grabs only ~1 dB GR on a peaky drum bus even at min threshold/4:1 — engage compressor_fast_attack='In' to actually compress drums; here that RAISED crest (fast attack + 0.1 s release = transient-emphasis), so MEASURE crest+GR for your material.

target_signature.source: bus_70s_balanced.wav (60 s dry drum bus, -1 dBFS)
target_signature.note: peak-normalized; crest UP = punch. true-peak -1.0 dBTP.

notes: EVERY SSL CS2 param is a discrete enum in Pedalboard. Numeric ones (gains/thresholds/ratio/trims/Q/mix/width) accept a plain float via setattr, but STRING enums ('In'/'Out','E'/'G','Shelf'/'Bell','RMS'/'Peak','Gate'/'Exp') and the LOG-STEPPED frequencies need exact values -> use THIS harness (apply_vst_preset.py setattr), NOT apply-vst-chain's float-only dict.

high_pass_filter_hz is log-stepped: 35.0 is valid, 40.0 throws 'not in list'. If you change it, pick a value the plugin accepts (the harness try/excepts a miss and leaves it OUT - which silently disables the HPF). low_pass_filter_khz='OUT' = LP off.
Default order is Filters -> EQ -> Dynamics. To compress into the EQ, add dynamics_pre_eq='In'. For frequency-conscious comp, route eq_to_s_c='In' or filters_to_s_c='In'.

E vs G EQ is SUBTLE but real (measured): G is slightly brighter (higher centroid), E slightly warmer/fuller in the upper-mids. E chosen here for drum warmth; swap eq_type='G' for a cleaner/airier top.

Gentler MIX-BUS variant: drop compressor_ratio to 2.0, raise compressor_threshold_db so GR is ~1-2 dB, consider compressor_fast_attack='Out' for transparent leveling, ease the EQ to +-2 dB. Parallel: compressor_mix < 100.
Auto make-up is ON by default; offset with compressor_auto_make_up_offset_db. Re-set the threshold to YOUR track level after recall - presets don't carry your level.
